name: Text Highlight Color
what_it_does: Applies a highlighter color behind the text; the dropdown picks the color.
behavior: Opens subfeature:text-highlight-color-picker (dropdown). Contents (5 controls): Text Highlight Color, High-contrast only, No Color, Stop Highlighting, Color swatches. [the subfeature:text-highlight-color-picker flyout — items are endpoints; swatches pixel-sampled; sections: Gallery Filters] Appears as a highlighter pen over text with a yellow bar and dropdown.

connections.why: all apply a color (text / highlight / fill) to the selection
